text:
aaron.devex: Noticed some Dedicated customers reporting missing quota rows after the route-affinity header rename went live in canary. Console shows 0 tokens for some routes. Anyone seen this?

kim.eng-platform: We flipped the opt-in header `X-Route-Affinity` -> `X-Route-Affinity-V2` on canary at 02:15 UTC. Expected safe fallback to the old key but apparently the merge logic returns empty when both headers are present.

leah.eng-sdk: We shipped TS sdk 1.9.0 to add the new header (opt-in flag). The idea was to avoid double-routing by preferring V2 if present. Did the platform expect V2 to be authoritative or additive?

tom.eng-runtime: Runtime assumed the headers were additive hints and would pick the highest priority hint. The recent change made V2 authoritative, but the header-parser treats missing-value as empty string if multiple headers are present which led to a zeroed route-id.

nina.product: Impact: billing and per-route quota dashboards both show empty route name -> group into "unattributed" line item. Customers can't reconcile. We need a mitigation plan.

aaron.devex: Short-term mitigation: revert authoritative behavior and accept the first non-empty hint. Can we patch quickly?

kim.eng-platform: I'll open a hotfix PR: prefer first non-empty, prefer v2 only when it's non-empty, and add defensive parsing for comma-delimited hints.

leah.eng-sdk: Also, TS SDK inadvertently started sending header arrays for multipart requests (fetch header serialization quirk). Patch is ready in branch but waiting on runtime test sign-off.

tom.eng-runtime: Canary deploy scheduled. I'll add a synthetic test that sends both headers and header arrays. If it passes, we roll the fix to 20% traffic.

aaron.devex: Console request: expose raw incoming header for 14 days as a sampled debug stream so CS can match examples to charges. Keep sampling low by default.

kim.eng-platform: Agreed. We'll add a sampled debug wire to the console telemetry tile at 0.5% default. Add toggle per-customer.

leah.eng-sdk: For the SDK release notes: note that Node http/undici may fold duplicate headers differently. Recommend snippet for Node users to normalize arrays -> string.

leah.eng-sdk: Snippet: 
```
// coerce arrays to single header
const h = req.headers;
if (Array.isArray(h['x-route-affinity'])) h['x-route-affinity'] = h['x-route-affinity'].find(Boolean) || h['x-route-affinity'][0];
```

kim.eng-platform: Also adding telemetry tag `header.source=client|proxy|sdk` to help attribution. We'll only enable full tag for internal accounts at first.

nina.product: Timeline: hotfix to runtime now, SDK patch cut today, console debug tile + customer toggle next week, public deprecation 21 days after canary fix. Update customer migration page.

deploy-bot: hotfix canary deploy started on hosts 3-5 at 03:10 UTC :rocket:

tom.eng-runtime: Canary tests green on header-array cases. Rolling to 20% in 10 mins.

leah.eng-sdk: Pushed TS 1.9.1 with header-array mitigation. CI green; will publish on next release window.

aaron.devex: Thanks. After rollout please send a short note with example logs that CS can use to match charges. We'll also prepare a small FAQ about header casing/arrays for customers that run proxies which mutate headers.

kim.eng-platform: Filing internal postmortem doc and adding a new unit test for header precedence semantics so this doesn't regress.

nina.product: Adding to release calendar and customer comms draft.

aaron.devex: Closing loop here. If we see more "unattributed" spikes we escalate to incident. Great job team.
